metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: Sawérigading marries all his nieces except for two. He then visits all vassals in Luwuq and travels further. He reaches Tompoq Tikkaq, where everyone is in mourning over the banishing of princess Wé Tenrirawé, who it had been feared would commit incest with her twin brother Palawagauq. Other journeys of Sawérigading are described, even ones overseas, among others to the Moluccas to witness the tattooing of the regent of Maloku. In Malatunrung he has an affair with the wife of La Tenroaji.
